items.known: CKV_AWS_44 Ensure Neptune storage is securely encrypted (resource aws_neptune_cluster.default)
items.remediation: Set storage_encrypted = true in the aws_neptune_cluster resource. Optionally specify a kms_key_arn pointing to a customer-managed KMS key for stronger key control.

items.known: CKV_AWS_101 Ensure Neptune logging is enabled (resource aws_neptune_cluster.default)
items.remediation: Add an enable_cloudwatch_logs_exports = ["audit"] attribute to the aws_neptune_cluster resource to stream audit logs to CloudWatch Logs.

scores.reason: Correctly fixes the check by setting aws_neptune_cluster.storage_encrypted = true; KMS key note is optional.
Correct and specific: add enable_cloudwatch_logs_exports = ["audit"] on aws_neptune_cluster to enable Neptune audit logging.
